checked_items.correction: Maximum ground current is 5 mA (not 'not found'/3 mA assumed): worst-case 5V_ISO load becomes 2 x 9.7 + 0.74 + 5 = 25.1 mA = 0.38 W at 15 V and R_pre <= (14.25-7.0)/0.0251 = 289 ohm (270 ohm still passes, margin 7 %). checked_items.item: Omron G9EA-1 DC12 contact and coil ratings
checked_items.evidence: omronfs.omron.com/en_US/ecb/products/pdf/en-g9ea.pdf ('Cat. No. J186-E1-01'): 'Rated load 60 A at 400 VDC, 100 A at 120 VDC'; 'Rated carry current 60 A'; 'Maximum switching voltage 400 V'; 'Maximum switching current 100 A'; 'Electrical endurance 400 VDC, 60 A, 3,000 ops. min.'; 'Overload interruption 180 A at 400 VDC (100 times min.)'; 'Reverse polarity interruption -60 A at 200 VDC (1,000 times min.)'; 'Maximum interruption current 600 A at 300 VDC'; 'Between coil and contacts 2,500 VAC, 1 min'; coil 12 VDC row '417 | 28.8 | 75% max. | 8% min. | 130% of rated voltage (at 23C within 10 minutes) | Approx. 5 W'; size 73 x 36 x 67.2 mm.

checked_items.item: TDK PTC B59773C0120A070 parameters (Vmax 560 V, Vlink 800 VDC, R25 120 ohm, Tref 130 C, Cth 2.1 J/K)
checked_items.evidence: TDK short-form tdk-electronics.tdk.com/inf/130/ptc_inrushcurrentlimiters.pdf (Edition 2015): 'B59773C0120A070 | 560 | 800 | 500 | +-25 | 115 | 1.4 | 12.5 | 16.5 | 7.0' (Vmax 560 V, Vlink,max 800 V, RR 500 ohm, Tref 115 C, Cth 1.4 J/K). Farnell-hosted TDK datasheet farnell.com/datasheets/2921121.pdf (February 2018, the document the agent cited): 'B59773C0120A070 | C774 | 440 | 620 | ... | +-25 | 115 | 0.6 | 80' (Vmax 440 V AC, Vlink,max 620 V DC, Tref 115 C, Cth 0.6 J/K). TDK sample-kit catalog / Mouser (search): 440 V AC / 620 V DC, 500 ohm +-25 %, Tref 120 C, Cth 0.6 J/K. No TDK source gives 120 ohm, 130 C or 2.1 J/K. The N-element formula with K = 1 for a DC source is present in the 2018 datasheet.
checked_items.correction: The ordering code and the parameter set do not belong together; re-select the PTC from the current TDK datasheet row that has the intended R25 and confirm Vmax/Vlink against 480 V DC. With the published B59773C0120A070 values (R ~500 ohm, Cth 0.6 J/K, Tref 115 C): tau = 30 ms, 99 % in ~140 ms, peak ~0.9-1.0 A, 11.5 K per charge, N = 0.21 (about 5x margin, not 21x), and the 440 V AC Vmax of the 2018 row must be checked against the 480 V survival voltage.

CB-SN-001: the 10.0 kOhm bottom resistor and the 330 pF feedback capacitor are the same values as the TIDA instance; the agent recomputed the ratio (602 V full scale) and the corner (32 kHz), so this is acceptable reuse, but it should be labelled as re-derived rather than implied to be independent.

PE-PCB-004..008 are cited like knowledge records but are not in the knowledge index ('unknown id'); they live in docs/pcb-design-rules.md and automation/verification/pcb_rules.json, so their text was not verifiable through the query tool.
required_changes: PTC pre-charge element: B59773C0120A070 is published by TDK as Vmax 440 V AC / Vlink,max 620 V DC, Tref 115 C, Cth 0.6 J/K (Feb 2018 datasheet; 500 ohm +-25 % per TDK catalog/Mouser; 560 V / 800 V / 500 ohm / 1.4 J/K in the 2015 short-form) - never 120 ohm / 130 C / 2.1 J/K. Re-select the ordering code from the current TDK datasheet, recompute tau, peak current, dT per charge and N (with the published values: ~30 ms, ~1 A, 11.5 K, N 0.21), and check Vmax against the 480 V survival voltage.
Varistor: replace ordering code B72210S0381K101 (S10K385: 2.5 kA, 40 J, 0.4 W) with B72220S0381K101 (S20K385: 8 kA, 150 J, 1.0 W, vc,max 1025 V at 100 A) to match the quoted parameters.

NTC B57703M0103G040: correct the lead length to 45 +-3 mm (500 mm is B57703M0103A019) and the test voltage to 1000 V AC / 1 s; restate the insulation argument on that basis and confirm the lead gauge and operating range from the datasheet.
Fault latch: SN74LVC1G74DCKR does not exist; specify SN74LVC1G74DCUR (VSSOP-8) or SN74LVC1G74DCTR (SSOP-8).

TLV76050 budget: use the datasheet ground-current maximum of 5 mA (2 mA typ); worst-case 5V_ISO load 25.1 mA / 0.38 W at 15 V; R_pre limit becomes 289 ohm (270 ohm acceptable); quote dropout at 100 mA as 0.9 V typ / 1.1 V max (25 C) / 1.2 V max over temperature.
Bleeder/indicator string: the 2 x 220 k path sees 240 V and 0.26 W per 1206 element at 480 V; use >= 3 elements or HV-rated resistors and correct the '<= 160 V per element' statement.

Relay: relabel the 180 A / 400 VDC figure as 'overload interruption' (reverse polarity is -60 A at 200 VDC); state explicitly that the G9EA-1 (maximum switching voltage 400 V) is never required to break above 400 V although the bus reaches 440-480 V, or select a relay rated for >= 480 VDC switching; use the listed code G9EJ-1-E-UVD DC12 for the alternative.

Minor datasheet alignments: TMCS1133 80 Arms is at TA = 25 C (44 Arms at 125 C); AMC1311 creepage/clearance >= 8.5 mm; UCC21710 APWM accuracy +-3 % without calibration; F28335 analog pins clamp a diode above VDDA2 (3.3 V) and 0-3 V is the conversion range - fix the clamp-current expression.

Record the now-known literature numbers (TLV1702 SBOS589D, TLV760 SNVSAV1A, OPA2320 SBOS513F, TPS3808 SBVS050N) and upgrade OPA2320/TLV760 from 'manufacturer-page' to 'fetched-datasheet'; keep KLKD020 melting I2t as an open item (sources blocked automated download) or benchmark against PV-20A10F pre-arc I2t 34 A2s.
summary: The sensing and fault-logic core is confirmed: TMCS1133C2AQDVGR (SBOSAG0E rev. May 2026: 50 mV/A, 0.33 V, -4.6..57.4 A at 3.3 V, VOC = S*IOC/2.5, 100/250 ns, +-2/+-10 %, 3.5 A hysteresis, 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced, orderable and Active; TMCS1133B1QDVGR indeed not an orderable), AMC1311BDWVR (SBAS786C: 2 V FSR, 2.516 V clipping, IDD1 7.1/9.7 mA, 1500 Vrms / 2120 VDC), UCC21710-Q1 (SLUSDH8D: 0.6-4.5 V -> 88-10 %, IAIN 196/200/209 uA, RST/EN > 1000 ns, deglitch 28-60 ns, 130 ns max), TLV1702, OPA2320, REF3125, TPS3808G33 and the F28335 2 mA clamp all match their datasheets, and every calculation reproduces to rounding. The power-path auxiliaries carry factual errors: the PTC B59773C0120A070 is not a 120 ohm / 130 C / 2.1 J/K part in any TDK document (440-560 V, ~500 ohm, 115 C, 0.6-1.4 J/K), so the pre-charge timing and the 21x thermal margin are wrong; the MOV code B72210S0381K101 is the S10K385 not the S20K385; the M703 NTC variant has 45 mm leads and a 1000 V AC test voltage (not 500 mm / ~150 V AC); SN74LVC1G74DCKR is not a real part number; the TLV760 maximum ground current is 5 mA (budget understated); the 2 x 220 k indicator string exceeds 160 V / 0.25 W per element; and the relay's 180 A figure is overload, not reverse-polarity, interruption while its 400 V switching limit sits below the 440-480 V bus. Knowledge citations were read correctly and no reference instance value was copied blindly. Verdict: confirmed with corrections.
